description: Create a new immutable card face from this scope’s artwork, logo or QR URL. Requires at least one of those inputs; a QR-only face needs no upload. Returns design_key and design_version for prepare_order or revise_order. Personal message, recipient and mailing details are supplied in the order’s cards array. Reuse an existing composition when no new face is needed.

artwork_asset_id.description: asset_id with kind artwork from read_private_content in this scope. Supply at least one artwork asset, logo asset or QR URL.

composition_id.description: Caller-generated UUID for this composition. Retrying with the same ID and identical fields returns the same card (reused: true); the same ID with different fields is CONFLICT, so use a new UUID for a different card.

logo_asset_id.description: asset_id with kind logo from read_private_content in this scope. Optional when artwork_asset_id or qr_url is supplied.

order_access_token.description: Exact private order_access_token returned by open_private_content for this scope. Keep it private and never invent one.

qr_url.description: Full HTTP(S) destination printed as a QR code; Paddock does not fetch it. A QR-only card needs no uploaded asset.

scope_id.description: Exact scope_id returned by open_private_content. All supplied asset IDs must belong to this scope.

title.description: Short private name for this card, shown to the buyer only.

name: compose_private_card
title: Compose a private card
